title: fix(staging): preserve link lists in typed DataFrame exports
body: ## Summary Keep `link_urls` as an object column when `convert_to_dataframe(..., set_dtypes=True)` applies its dtype map. `ElementMetadata.link_urls` contains a list of strings, but its map entry currently uses `StringDtype`, turning the whole list into a string representation. This loses the sequence structure in JSON records and Hugging Face datasets and prevents URLs from being exploded alongside the corresponding link text and offsets. Use the same object representation already used for other list-valued metadata such as `link_texts`. ## Validation - Added 11 regression cases: unchanged upstream produces 6 failures and 5 passes. - Exercised native pandas multi-column `explode`, JSON records, and `datasets.Dataset.from_pandas`, with typed/untyped controls, missing links, Unicode URLs, and source-metadata preservation. - New tests plus existing DataFrame, pandas-dtype, and flattening tests: **31 passed** on Python 3.12; 65 unrelated tests were deselected. The existing email-derived DataFrame test also passed after its real fixture and dependencies were made available. - Lockfile-pinned Ruff 0.15.10 check/format and `git diff --check` passed. The full repository suite was not run. ## Checklist - [x] The PR title is a user-facing release-note entry with a conventional commit prefix. - [ ] Please apply the `bug` category label during maintainer triage. - [x] No changelog edit or version bump.
